Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
Heard Learned counsel for the petitioner on I.A.No. 171582/2024 seeking exemption from surrendering.
The petitioner was convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 304B and 498A, IPC.

Appeal no.301/2002 was preferred by the appellant/petitioner is pending before the High Court of Calcutta wherein, the appellant was granted indulgence of bail by suspending his sentence vide order dated 21.01.2003.

When the appeal was called out for hearing by the Learned Single Judge of Calcutta High Court on 22.05.2024, neither the appellant/petitioner nor the counsel was available to argue the matter whereupon, the High Court cancelled the bail granted to the Sujit Santra @ Sujit Kumar Santra vs State Of West Bengal on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192656510/
1 appellant/petitioner.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thereupon, the instant Special Leave Petition has been moved by the appellant/petitioner.
It may be noted that the appeal preferred by the appellant/petitioner is still pending.

This Court feels that rather than approaching this Court by way of this Special Leave Petition, the appellant/petitioner would be better advised to move an application before the High Court seeking recall of the order dated 22.05.2024.
The petitioner is granted exemption from surrendering for a period of two weeks.

In the meantime,
the matter be listed before the Court.

(GEETA JOSHI) (POOJA SHARMA)
SENIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT COURT MASTER (NSH)
